# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** eight-year-old  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Dora](../character/dora.md) (sibling), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Davy Keith is a handsome child with a round head covered in fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets. He has a snub nose and features a dimple in one of his cheeks.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy Keith possesses a natural knack for winning love, though his face routinely reflects mirth and mischief. Naturally curious and inquisitive, he is full of playful antics such as making faces, and he struggles to sit still. While he is described as a reformed character, he can be heedless, forgetful, and lacking in imagination, approaching matters in a strictly practical way. When engaging in tasks, he can also display more energy and zeal than discretion. Aspiring to his own future goals, he wants to become a storekeeper so he can keep plenty of candy and bananas.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P14](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0014), +6 more_

## History

Davy Keith lost his father as a baby and was raised with little discipline by a sick mother. He arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside his twin sister [Dora](../character/dora.md), quickly establishing himself as a handful with his mischievous behavior, such as hiding a toad in Marilla's bed. He continued to cause trouble by trapping [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse and lying about it, though he broke down in remorse once he understood that dishonesty was wrong, earning both punishment and affection from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Davy repeatedly tested boundaries through actions like stealing plum jam, testing warnings by skipping his prayers, and ruining lemon pies intended for a famous visiting author. Despite his frequent misbehavior, table manners, and jealousy over Anne's attention to other children, he often engaged in intimate bedtime conversations with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about trying to be good. His long-term future at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) was ultimately secured when the death of his uncle, [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), provided financial support for his care.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), +29 more_

## Quotes

> "You don’t look like a lady who’d whip a little boy just ’cause he couldn’t keep still. Didn’t you find it awful hard to keep still when you was only ‘s old as me?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)

> "You was a girl once, I s’pose, though it’s awful funny to think of it. Dora can sit still . . . but there ain’t much fun in it I don’t think. Seems to me it must be slow to be a girl. Here, Dora, let me liven you up a bit."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)

> "Marilla washed it yesterday . . . and Mrs. Wiggins scoured me with hard soap the day of the funeral. That’s enough for one week. I don’t see the good of being so awful clean. It’s lots more comfable being dirty."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031)

> "But it was such a jolly big caterpillar . . . I picked him up on the church steps just as we went in. It seemed a pity to waste him. And say, wasn’t it fun to hear that girl yell?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043)

> “I . . . did something else today,” went on Davy in a muffled voice. “I’m sorry now but I’m awful scared to tell you. You won’t be very cross, will you? And you won’t tell Marilla, will you?”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) serves as an affectionate guardian and friend to Davy after [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings him to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Although Davy frequently causes trouble and tests boundaries—such as hiding a toad in Marilla's bed or trapping his sister in a toolhouse—[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gently guides and educates him on right from wrong. Despite his mischievous antics, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) holds a special affection for him.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), +15 more_

- Friend of — affectionate guardian and friend  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P37](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0037), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P34](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0034)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister who comes with him to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy frequently targets her with his pranks, such as coaxing her into a pigpen before pumping water on her, complaining about her to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and locking her inside a toolhouse. While [Dora](../character/dora.md) exhibits consistently good behavior, Davy's mischievous treatment of her often leads to his reprimands and lessons in honesty.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +18 more_

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +7 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Davy's third cousin and authority figure who brings him and his sister to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy frequently causes mischief under her care, such as placing a toad in her bed and testing her warnings by skipping his prayers. Despite having to discipline him for his lies and pranks, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to sharing a special affection for Davy over his well-behaved sister.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), +11 more_
